notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello pizza delivery enthusiasts!

We've deployed a fix to some of the bugs.

Patchnotes (1.0.1):

[list]
[*] Omnicluster Free Delivery mode: pizza bag is now accessible.
[*] Omnicluster Free Delivery mode: a number of sprite rendering errors fixed.
[*] Main Menu: menu buttons separated apart for easier visualisation.
[*] Resolution: a work-in-progress fix for screens with larger resolution. Will monitor the monitors (ha-ha)
[*] Small updates in level 1 and level 30
[/list]

Thank you and happy delivering!
